inferences: This suggests a joint project combining failure examination, service measurements and controlled fatigue testing could distinguish interacting contributors rather than simply repeat ambient qualification.

The published plate experiments do not validate a mechanism for painted hollow-section joints at 2–6 °C. Different material, geometry, coating and loading make direct transfer risky; condensation-control and corrosion-analysis capability also remain unverified.

The proposal is conditional: Erić is open to this project format, but his availability is unknown. Shared equipment and company project duties likely make a bounded, scheduled campaign more practical than an open-ended investigation.
proposedActions: First experiment: propose AutomVoj fabricate matching painted joints and supply service records; Erić would lead failure analysis and testing. Use separate tuning and held-out validation specimens, checking independence across fabrication batches. Run an eight-condition matrix: baseline, each factor alone, all pairs and all three. Independently define thermal cycling as measured excursions versus constant chilled temperature, condensation as controlled wet versus dry surfaces, and vibration as measured loaded-belt excitation versus matched static mean load. Include a room-temperature loaded comparator; match geometry, coating, mean load and exposure, randomise order and replicate conditions. Measure strain, temperature, wetness, cycles to detectable cracking, crack growth, origin, path and fracture morphology. Proposed go/no-go: the best-supported explanation must reproduce site-observed location and fracture features in at least two held-out joints under representative 2–6 °C service exposure, with repeatable controlled contrasts resolving claimed interactions. No isolated null result ends the search. Insufficient replication, unresolved interactions or unavailable validation evidence means hold, not success; accelerated testing cannot establish 18-month durability.

Propose an initial two-week evidence and feasibility stage: document both failed sections before authorising any cuts; compare failed and unaffected joints; establish material, weld, filler and coating specifications; and plan strain, vibration, temperature and humidity monitoring. Confirm chamber fit, simultaneous loading and moisture control, external support if needed, staff allocation and laboratory booking before committing to testing.

Propose an eight-week pilot after access and specimen readiness, subject to measured cycle durations. Use the findings to select welding, filler or geometry changes on tuning specimens, then test the selected configuration independently. Negotiate a measurable improvement target before modification tests; retain the same site-matched failure definition and avoid treating laboratory improvement as proof that warranty replacements will stop.

What chamber dimensions, fixture limits, simultaneous thermal–mechanical capability, humidity control and booking dates are available?

content.markdown:
# Explaining chilled-service cracking in AutomVoj conveyor welds

## Verified facts
- AutomVoj reports painted mild-steel hollow-section frames cracking at main crossmember-to-stringer welds after about 18 months in cold stores typically operating at 2–6 °C. It reports 14 warranty assembly replacements this year. [F1]
- The company reports that room-temperature loaded tests pass. It suspects thermal cycling, condensation and loaded-belt vibration acting together; that explanation is not established. [F2]
- AutomVoj's retained failure evidence comprises site photographs, measurements and two failed sections. [F3]
- AutomVoj lacks low-temperature cyclic-testing equipment and expertise. Erić's chamber and servo-hydraulic machine are shared with two other groups, with extended campaigns subject to advance scheduling. [F4]
- AutomVoj has no dedicated R&D department; its chief engineer and two senior automation engineers divide their time between live projects and improvement work. [F5]
- Erić's research compared isothermal fatigue with in-phase and out-of-phase thermomechanical fatigue in butt-welded S275JR plates. His stated interests include joint projects on low-temperature or combined-loading fatigue testing. [F6]

## Potential benefits
- For the company: The pilot could identify which service factors explain the observed cracking and provide evidence for choosing a welding, filler or joint-design change rather than another ambient-only qualification.
- For the researcher: Subject to agreement and access, Erić could test whether thermomechanical fatigue methods transfer to coated conveyor joints, using retained failure evidence, measured service histories and representative specimens.

## Our inference
- This suggests a joint project combining failure examination, service measurements and controlled fatigue testing could distinguish interacting contributors rather than simply repeat ambient qualification.
- The published plate experiments do not validate a mechanism for painted hollow-section joints at 2–6 °C. Different material, geometry, coating and loading make direct transfer risky; condensation-control and corrosion-analysis capability also remain unverified.
- The proposal is conditional: Erić is open to this project format, but his availability is unknown. Shared equipment and company project duties likely make a bounded, scheduled campaign more practical than an open-ended investigation.

## Proposed next steps
- First experiment: propose AutomVoj fabricate matching painted joints and supply service records; Erić would lead failure analysis and testing. Use separate tuning and held-out validation specimens, checking independence across fabrication batches. Run an eight-condition matrix: baseline, each factor alone, all pairs and all three. Independently define thermal cycling as measured excursions versus constant chilled temperature, condensation as controlled wet versus dry surfaces, and vibration as measured loaded-belt excitation versus matched static mean load. Include a room-temperature loaded comparator; match geometry, coating, mean load and exposure, randomise order and replicate conditions. Measure strain, temperature, wetness, cycles to detectable cracking, crack growth, origin, path and fracture morphology. Proposed go/no-go: the best-supported explanation must reproduce site-observed location and fracture features in at least two held-out joints under representative 2–6 °C service exposure, with repeatable controlled contrasts resolving claimed interactions. No isolated null result ends the search. Insufficient replication, unresolved interactions or unavailable validation evidence means hold, not success; accelerated testing cannot establish 18-month durability.
- Propose an initial two-week evidence and feasibility stage: document both failed sections before authorising any cuts; compare failed and unaffected joints; establish material, weld, filler and coating specifications; and plan strain, vibration, temperature and humidity monitoring. Confirm chamber fit, simultaneous loading and moisture control, external support if needed, staff allocation and laboratory booking before committing to testing.
- Propose an eight-week pilot after access and specimen readiness, subject to measured cycle durations. Use the findings to select welding, filler or geometry changes on tuning specimens, then test the selected configuration independently. Negotiate a measurable improvement target before modification tests; retain the same site-matched failure definition and avoid treating laboratory improvement as proof that warranty replacements will stop.

## Open questions
- Can Erić confirm availability and laboratory support for this joint project, and can AutomVoj name an engineering owner with time allocated around live projects?
- Can AutomVoj authorise evidence-preserving examination, supply specifications and matching joints, and arrange customer-site monitoring of loading, shutdowns, washdowns and condensation?
- What chamber dimensions, fixture limits, simultaneous thermal–mechanical capability, humidity control and booking dates are available?
- What budget, delivery deadline and customer acceptance requirements apply, including the improvement threshold and field evidence needed before adopting a revised joint?
